newTests.name: Clearing a tab's capture forgets the detail behind its refs. > console clear on the tab the session drives > forgets that tab's refs and leaves the other tab's alone
The detail behind a ref lives exactly as long as the listing that shows it. > one tab floods the network window > keeps the detail and the parked response of every ref the listing still shows
Integration tests for console_get, console_clear, errors_get, errors_clear > console messages > captures a tab the page opened, without switching to it
The tab that replaces a crashed one captures like any other. > a session recovering from a renderer crash > captures the console of the tab it was handed
A tab opened by the page is instrumented as it appears. > a page that opens a tab of its own > instruments the new tab and gives it an id
Integration tests for network_route, network_unroute > network route lifecycle > routes a tab opened after it was added
A session at its capture ceiling says so once, and a clear gives it back. > a session that has spent its capture budget > stops recording, says so, and records again after a clear
